mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within the last month signals a strong supply-side response, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is positive and housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% in the last month, it signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending rise.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 positive growth & HOUST increases > 5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in the last month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as wage pressures and consumer spending increase.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k & UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
